company.name: CompliantLLM
company.shortDescription: CompliantLLM provides AI security and compliance tools to detect data leaks and assess risks from enterprise GenAI usage.
company.description: CompliantLLM provides AI security and compliance tools focused on monitoring and governing generative AI usage within enterprises. The platform analyzes logs from third-party GenAI tools to detect data leaks, PII exposure, and anomalous or malicious interactions. It offers risk assessment for GenAI products, surfacing unsanctioned AI usage and helping security teams evaluate AI vendors and integrations. CompliantLLM includes features for autogenerated regulatory training and security documentation to prepare employees and reduce breach risk. The company also offers data tooling such as FiddleCube to generate task-specific datasets and support fine-tuning workflows. Its solutions are intended for security, compliance, and engineering teams seeking visibility and control over AI-driven data flows.
